🔥 ai-copywriter | Python
🎯 Primary Use Case: To generate marketing copy that is both effective in capturing attention and indistinguishable from human writing, by deeply understanding the target audience and simplifying complex concepts.
✨ Key Features: • Writes attention-grabbing copy (clickbait titles, short descriptions, microcopy, subject lines) • Removes AI-generated writing patterns for a human tone
📖 Summary: This AI copywriter is a portable agent skill that writes compelling marketing copy, such as headlines and product descriptions, while ensuring the output reads like human-written text. It achieves this by integrating real copywriting skills and marketing knowledge with a humanizer component that removes AI-generated writing patterns.
